children: BCB Bancorp’s third-quarter loss widened from the prior-year quarter, as a sharp increase in credit-loss provisioning and a tax charge for a full valuation allowance outweighed higher noninterest income. Net interest income declined amid a smaller balance sheet, while the net interest margin improved as funding costs fell.
² Reported as “Net (Loss) Income available to common stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: A comprehensive portfolio review led to higher commercial and multifamily reserves; $74.7M of third-quarter provision was attributed to that portfolio.
: The Bank sold $204.3M of problem loans, resulting in a $42.3M charge-off to the allowance.
: The Bank transferred $100.9M of loans to held-for-sale status and recorded a related $44.2M charge-off.
: The Bank transferred $70.2M of cannabis loans to held-for-sale as part of its planned exit from cannabis banking.
